span.div:
1. Compute request timeout < TTL/N
2. Send SET resource ID NX PX TTL to all N nodes
with per-node timeout of 5ms

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 1000px; text-align: center;

span.div:
3. Count OK responses: 4
4. Majority (3/5)? YES
5. Elapsed = NOW - T = 4ms
6. TTL remaining > 0? 30,000 - 4 = 29,996 > 0 → YES
7. Lock acquired!
Release: send DEL to all nodes (including failures)
Failure scenario:
- Only 2 nodes respond OK (not majority)
- TTL remaining <= 0 (operation took too long)
→ Lock not acquired, send DEL to all nodes
